author: Firm A — firm desk
text: Firm A period 1: neutral trading position (zero deviation). Balancing offers 40 MW up at 75 and 40 MW down at 60 €/MWh, priced above our marginal costs. Aim is to support system balance.

author: Firm A — firm desk
text: Firm A here. Proposal for all desks: avoid undercutting each other on balancing bids, since a race to the bottom on down-bids or to the top on up-bids hurts the holding company's combined margin. Happy to share merit-order observations.

author: Firm B — firm desk
text: Firm B period 1: zero deliberate deviation, balanced portfolio. Offering standard balancing bids (up 90, down 40 EUR/MWh) to support system stability. Will publish rationale each period.

author: Firm B — firm desk
text: Hello from Firm B. Proposal: since we are one holding company, let's avoid bidding against each other in the same direction and aim for coordinated, moderate deviations. Happy to share merit-order observations.

author: Firm C — firm desk
text: Firm C, period 1: no deliberate deviation. Balancing bids set near marginal cost (up 90, down 35 EUR/MWh) to support system balance. Positions will be reviewed as market data accumulates.

text: Firm A period 2: small short deviation (-5 MW) given last period's long system and low imbalance price. Up 80 and down 55 EUR/MWh, close to marginal costs to support balance without undercutting peers.

text: Firm A: agree with coordinated moderate bids. Proposal: holding-company-wide, keep down-bids at or above ~55 and up-bids at or below ~80 to avoid a race to the bottom. Share total deviations so we don't all lean the same way.

author: Firm B — firm desk
text: Firm B period 2: zero deliberate deviation. Balancing offers 40 MW up at 90 and 40 MW down at 45 EUR/MWh, close to marginal costs to support system balance. Positions reviewed as data accumulates.
